name: G-PBGD
tagline: Gradient-based Penalized Bilevel Gradient Descent: replaces the inner solve with a single penalty-augmented outer gradient step.
diff_from_baseline: Kwon et al. 2024 (G-PBGD). Penalty-based first-order bilevel solver that avoids nested inner-loops by treating $y$ as a free variable in a penalized formulation; canonical baseline in the V-PBGD repo.

name: RHG
tagline: Reverse-mode Hyper-Gradient (Iterative Differentiation): unrolls T inner SGD steps and back-propagates through all of them to compute the hypergradient.
diff_from_baseline: Maclaurin et al. 2015 / Franceschi et al. 2017–18 (RHG / ITD). Reverse-mode hyper-gradient via full inner-loop unrolling. Canonical bilevel baseline; high memory cost due to autodiff tape over T steps.

name: T-RHG
tagline: Truncated RHG: identical to RHG but back-propagates through only the last K inner steps, trading hypergradient bias for lower memory and runtime.
diff_from_baseline: Shaban et al. 2019 (T-RHG, AISTATS). Truncated reverse-hyper-gradient: cheaper memory than full RHG, with bounded bias when the inner trajectory contracts.

name: V-PBGD
tagline: Value-function Penalized Bilevel Gradient Descent: alternating inner refinement + penalty-based outer update with scheduled $\gamma$.
diff_from_baseline: Liu et al. 2024 (V-PBGD). Value-function penalty-based bilevel optimizer that schedules a single penalty multiplier and uses one inner-step per outer iteration; the original V-PBGD reference.
